description: End-to-end workflow for designing, versioning, validating, deploying, and rolling back API gateway configurations and content (routes, plugins, policies) across environments.

workspace_id.description: Logical workspace or tenant identifier that groups APIs, environments, and gateway configurations.

api_id.description: Identifier of an API definition managed by the gateway.

api_version_id.description: Identifier of a specific version of an API definition.

content_bundle_id.description: Identifier for a content bundle containing route specs, plugins, and policies for a given API version.

environment_id.description: Identifier for a deployment environment (e.g., dev, staging, prod).

deployment_id.description: Identifier for a specific deployment of a content bundle to an environment.

change_request_id.description: Identifier for a change request tracking review and approval of gateway content changes.

policy_template_id.description: Identifier for a reusable policy template (e.g., rate limiting, auth).

gateway_node_id.description: Identifier for a specific gateway node or node group within an environment.

functions.name: create_api_definition
functions.description: Create a new API definition and initial version within a workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace in which to create the API.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier for the API, used in routing and organization.

description.description: Detailed description of the API's purpose and behavior.

owner.description: Information about the team or user that owns this API.

contact_emails.description: Contact emails for escalation and notifications.

initial_version.description: Initial version metadata and base routing configuration.

visibility.description: Who can access this API version.

base_path.description: Base path prefix for all routes in this API version.

targets.description: List of upstream targets for load balancing.

tags.description: Optional tags for target classification (e.g., canary, primary).

timeout_ms.description: Request timeout to the upstream in milliseconds.

tags.description: Arbitrary key-value tags for this API.

functions.returns: Created API metadata and first api_version_id.

functions.name: create_content_bundle
functions.description: Create or update a content bundle for an API version, including routes, plugins, and policies.

base_bundle_id.description: Optional existing content_bundle_id to clone and modify.

summary.description: Short description of what this bundle changes or enables.

routes.description: Route definitions included in this bundle.

path.description: Route path relative to the API base_path, may include path parameters.

headers.description: Required header patterns for this route.

value_pattern.description: Regex or wildcard pattern for header value.

plugins.description: Plugins applied at the route level.

policies.description: Inline or templated policies enforced on this route.

policy_template_id.description: Reference to a shared policy template.

inline.description: Inline policy definition when not using a template.

overrides.description: Overrides of template defaults at the route level.

enforcement_mode.description: Whether the policy is actively enforced or only monitored.

global_plugins.description: Plugins applied at the API version level.

changelog.description: Human-readable changelog of this bundle vs previous.

functions.returns: New or updated content_bundle_id with summarized bundle metadata.

functions.name: validate_content_bundle
functions.description: Run static and dynamic validations on a content bundle before requesting deployment.

validation_profile.description: Validation rigor level; may influence which rules are applied.

simulate_traffic.description: Optional configuration to simulate sample traffic during validation.

scenarios.description: Traffic scenarios to replay or simulate.

lint_rules.description: Optional list of additional lint rule IDs to enable.

functions.returns: Validation report including status, errors, warnings, and suggested fixes.

functions.name: create_change_request
functions.description: Create a change request for review and approval of a content bundle before deployment.

target_environments.description: Environments where this bundle is proposed to be deployed.

traffic_shaping.description: Optional traffic split configuration for canary/blue-green.

ramp_up_steps.description: Sequence of traffic percentages to apply in order.

requested_by.description: User or service that initiated this change request.

description.description: Detailed description of the change and reasoning.

blast_radius.description: Textual description of potential blast radius.

rollback_plan.description: Proposed rollback steps if deployment causes issues.

functions.returns: Created change_request_id with initial status and review requirements.

functions.name: review_change_request
functions.description: Approve or reject a change request, optionally with conditions or required fixes.

reviewer_id.description: Identifier of the reviewer performing this action.

comment.description: Reviewer's comment or explanation for the decision.

conditions.description: Optional conditions that must be met before deployment.

required_by.description: Deadline or stage by which this condition must be satisfied (e.g., 'before_prod').

functions.returns: Updated change request status, review history, and any outstanding conditions.

functions.name: plan_deployment
functions.description: Generate a concrete deployment plan for a validated and approved change request.

override_environments.description: Optionally override environments specified in the change request.

skip.description: Whether to skip deployment to this environment.

deploy_order.description: Explicit order for this environment in the deployment sequence.

node_selection.description: Configuration for selecting gateway nodes within each environment.

label_selector.description: When strategy is 'label_selector', select nodes matching these labels.

subset_node_ids.description: When strategy is 'subset', explicitly list node IDs.

dry_run.description: If true, only compute the plan without persisting it as executable.

functions.returns: Deployment plan including ordered steps, targeted gateway_node_ids, and estimated impact.

functions.name: execute_deployment
functions.description: Execute a prepared deployment plan to apply a content bundle to one or more environments.

environment_id.description: Environment to deploy to; if omitted, deploy across all planned environments.

safety_checks.description: Additional runtime safety checks before committing deployment.

max_error_rate_pct.description: Maximum allowed recent error rate before blocking deployment.

required_approvals.description: Minimal number of change request approvals required.

metadata.description: Execution metadata (e.g., run id, automation context).

functions.returns: Deployment execution summary including deployment_id(s) and initial status.

functions.name: get_deployment_status
functions.description: Get real-time status, progress, and health signals for a specific deployment.

include.description: Additional data to retrieve for the deployment.

metrics_window.description: Optional time window for metrics aggregation.

functions.returns: Deployment status, progress per environment and gateway_node_id, and any requested telemetry.

functions.name: rollback_deployment
functions.description: Rollback a deployment to the previous stable content bundle in one or more environments.

scope.description: Rollback scope: entire environment, specific nodes, or all environments in this deployment.

target_environment_id.description: Environment to rollback if scope is 'environment'.

gateway_node_ids.description: List of gateway nodes to rollback if scope is 'node'.

preserve_traffic_split.description: If true, keep current traffic splits but point stable traffic to the previous bundle.

force.description: Force rollback even if validation or checks fail.

functions.returns: Rollback operation result, including new deployment_id if a rollback deployment is created.

functions.name: retry_failed_steps
functions.description: Retry failed steps of a deployment, optionally with modified parameters or narrowed scope.

step_ids.description: Specific step IDs to retry; if omitted, retry all failed steps.

override_node_selection.description: Optionally override node selection for retries.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for each step.

functions.returns: Retry execution summary including updated statuses for affected steps.

functions.name: list_gateway_content
functions.description: List API gateway content (APIs, versions, bundles) within a workspace with filtering and pagination.

filter.description: Filtering criteria for APIs and content bundles.

environment_id.description: Filter to APIs with deployments in a specific environment.

status.description: Filter by high-level status of the latest deployment of each bundle.

labels.description: Match APIs or bundles that have all specified labels.

include.description: Optional related resources to include inline.

functions.returns: Paged list of APIs and related gateway content matching the filter.

functions.name: check_route_availability
functions.description: Check if a proposed route path and method combination is available or conflicts with existing routes.

environment_id.description: Environment to check against; if omitted, checks workspace-level definitions.

api_id.description: Optional API context for resolving base_path and overlaps.

path.description: Proposed route path relative to API base_path.

methods.description: HTTP methods to check for conflicts.

hosts.description: Optional hostnames used by the route.

include_candidates.description: If true, return close matches that might cause ambiguity.

functions.returns: Availability result indicating conflicts, ambiguous matches, and suggested alternatives.

functions.name: get_effective_config
functions.description: Get the effective merged configuration for an API version in a specific environment, including all applied bundles, policies, and plugins.

include.description: Additional details to include in the effective config view.

functions.returns: Effective gateway configuration for the specified API version and environment in the requested format.

functions.name: search_deployments
functions.description: Faceted search across API gateway deployments with rich filters, time windows, pagination, and aggregations.

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of API gateway deployment summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_deployments
functions.description: Create multiple API gateway deployments in a single atomic or best-effort batch with idempotency and partial-commit options.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A bulk-job descriptor with per-item outcomes, created API gateway deployment ids, error reasons for failures, and an aggregate counts summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_deployments
functions.description: Apply patch-style updates to many API gateway deployments with optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-item update outcomes (success/failure with reason), new versions for each API gateway deployment, and a summary of skipped and quarantined items.

functions.name: bulk_archive_deployments
functions.description: Archive or soft-delete many API gateway deployments in one call with retention, audit reason, and webhook notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id outcome, new lifecycle state for each API gateway deployment, scheduled purge date if applicable, and a job id for tracking.

functions.name: export_deployments
functions.description: Export API gateway deployment datasets to an external sink in CSV, JSON, Parquet, or NDJSON with filters and signed-URL delivery.

split_by.description: Field to shard output by, e.g., tenant_id.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with job id, estimated row count, signed-URL(s) when applicable, and asynchronous completion event details.

functions.name: import_deployments
functions.description: Bulk-import API gateway deployment records from a file or staging table with schema mapping, validation, and quarantine handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An import job descriptor with counts of valid, invalid, and quarantined rows, sample error messages, and identifiers of created or updated API gateway deployments.

functions.name: subscribe_to_deployment_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive API gateway deployment lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created subscription record with id, secret rotation hint, active state, and an example test-event payload for the API gateway deployment.

functions.name: get_deployment_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a API gateway deployment, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the API gateway deployment, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.name: schedule_recurring_deployment_job
functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for API gateway deployments using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated schedule descriptor with id, next run time, effective cron, and any backfill plan summary for the API gateway deployment action.

functions.name: simulate_deployment_changes
functions.description: Preview the effect of a proposed change to a API gateway deployment without persisting, returning a diff and impact analysis.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A simulation report showing the resulting state of the API gateway deployment, a structured diff, policy-check verdicts, and a quantitative impact estimate (cost, latency, blast radius).

functions.name: request_deployment_approval
functions.description: Create an approval workflow request for a API gateway deployment change, with multi-stage approvers, SLA, and evidence attachments.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An approval-request descriptor with id, current stage, list of pending approvers, SLA deadlines, and links to the API gateway deployment under change.

functions.name: decide_deployment_approval
functions.description: Record an approver decision (approve, reject, request changes) on a pending API gateway deployment approval request.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

expected_stage.description: Optimistic concurrency check on the approval stage.

functions.returns: The updated approval-request state including new stage, list of completed and pending approvers, and any condition list applied to the API gateway deployment.

functions.name: add_deployment_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment, mention, or note to a API gateway deployment for collaboration and case-management context.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted comment record with id, threading info, visibility, mention/notification fan-out summary for the API gateway deployment.

functions.name: upload_deployment_attachment
functions.description: Upload or link a binary attachment (evidence, log bundle, screenshot, contract) to a API gateway deployment with scanning and retention.

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created attachment record with id, scan verdicts, signed download URL, checksum, and link to the API gateway deployment.

functions.name: create_deployment_snapshot
functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a API gateway deployment (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A snapshot record with id, size, checksum, encryption metadata, and a reference to the API gateway deployment version captured.

functions.name: restore_deployment_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a API gateway deployment from a snapshot with selectable scope, validation pre-checks, and notification on completion.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A restore-operation descriptor with operation id, pre-restore snapshot id, validation results, conflict resolutions applied, and final state of the API gateway deployment.

functions.name: get_deployment_metrics
functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for API gateway deployments over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A metrics result with aggregate values, percentiles, optional period-over-period deltas, sparkline series per group, and the API gateway deployment domain context.

functions.name: get_deployment_dashboard
functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for API gateway deployments combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the API gateway deployment context.

functions.name: create_deployment_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule applied to API gateway deployments with versioning, scope, and rollout strategy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated policy record with id, version, rollout plan, scope, and an effective-evaluation summary against current API gateway deployments.

functions.name: evaluate_deployment_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a API gateway deployment in dry-run, returning per-rule verdicts and proposed actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-policy and per-rule verdicts with reasons, trace data, and a list of proposed (or applied, when apply_actions=true) actions against the API gateway deployment.

functions.name: get_deployment_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the upstream and downstream dependency graph for a API gateway deployment including services, devices, tickets, and contracts.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A graph payload (nodes, edges, optional health and metrics) describing dependencies for the API gateway deployment, with depth and direction respected.

functions.name: link_deployment_to_related
functions.description: Create or remove an association between a API gateway deployment and another business object (incident, ticket, contract, asset).

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The resulting association record (or removal confirmation) including direction, relation type, and a snapshot of the related-object summary for the API gateway deployment.

functions.name: assign_deployment_owner
functions.description: Assign or reassign ownership/roles on a API gateway deployment with hand-off rules, watchers, and notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The updated assignment roster for the API gateway deployment with effective windows, hand-off receipts, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tag_deployments
functions.description: Apply, remove, or replace tags and labels on one or more API gateway deployments, with conflict resolution and audit.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id tag-application outcomes with final tag sets and counts of added/removed/skipped operations for each API gateway deployment.

functions.name: compare_deployment_versions
functions.description: Produce a structured diff between two versions (or snapshots) of a API gateway deployment with semantic equivalence handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A diff document describing added, removed, and changed fields between the two versions of the API gateway deployment, with optional side-by-side rendering.

functions.name: configure_deployment_retry_policy
functions.description: Configure default retry, backoff, and circuit-breaker policy applied to API gateway deployment operations and their downstream actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted retry/circuit-breaker policy with id, effective scope, and a summary of API gateway deployment operations that match the new policy.

functions.name: check_deployment_health
functions.description: Run a synthetic health/probe sweep against a API gateway deployment and its critical dependencies and return aggregated health status.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Aggregated health verdict for the API gateway deployment, per-probe results, dependency roll-up, and any alert notifications dispatched.

functions.name: clone_deployment
functions.description: Clone a API gateway deployment into a new instance with selective fields, optional rename, and link-back metadata.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The cloned API gateway deployment record with id, lineage link to the source, and a summary of fields reset, copied, or skipped.

functions.name: generate_deployment_report
functions.description: Generate a formatted API gateway deployment report (executive, operational, compliance) and deliver via email/object storage.

schedule_id.description: When generated by a recurring schedule.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A report-generation receipt with report id, download URL or delivery confirmation, page/sheet count, and the API gateway deployment window covered.

functions.name: escalate_deployment
functions.description: Escalate a API gateway deployment to a higher tier or owner group with reason, severity bump, and watcher fan-out.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The escalation record with new owner/tier, severity, SLA, watchers, and a log of notifications sent for the API gateway deployment.
